source:
## Balanced parentheses: the classic context-free language. The nested
## form is `("(" nested ")")` — repetition with an inner recursion, no
## left recursion, no counting.
grammar Balanced version "1.0.0" {
  ## nested = one unit or a sequence of units, inside optional parens.
  unit = ( "(" nested ")" ) as group
  nested = *( unit )
  top = ( nested ) as nested

  entry main: top

  test {
    accept "()"
    accept "(())()"
    accept "((()())())"
    reject "("
    reject "())"
  }
}
